label: PF Backlog 524
title: RCCA: commit hygiene - guard must block MIXED backlog-bookkeeping + unrelated files (any branch)
body:
## Problem / why
A delivery/bookkeeping commit mixed the intended data/backlog/** change with 15 pre-staged unrelated files
(knowledge-registry.json, learnings.json, portfolio.db, products/.conversations/*, intake/ideas/*). The
branch-guard BLOCKED the commit on develop (non-bookkeeping staged on a protected branch), but a feature-branch
commit did NOT block the MIX -> the unrelated files were swept in + merged.

## Acceptance criteria
- The commit guard BLOCKS a staged set that MIXES backlog bookkeeping (data/backlog/**) with non-bookkeeping
  files, on ANY branch (split into two commits).
- bookkeeping-only commits remain allowed (delivery); feature-only commits remain allowed.

## Root cause (5-Why)
1. Unrelated files landed in a delivery commit. 2. The commit swept pre-staged files. 3. The guard only blocked
on protected branches, not mixed sets on feature branches. 4. No commit-SCOPE check existed. 5. Guard: block
mixed backlog-bookkeeping + other staged sets everywhere.

## In scope
branch_guard mixed-commit check + test.

## Out of scope
Rewriting history (superseded/pushed already; benign tracked data).
